messages:
Jordan Patel: Quick follow-up from today's regional failover game day. Overall went well but we surfaced a few recurring gaps in the restore runbook and DNS steering. Posting a concise action list so we can own timelines.

Ashley Chen: +1. Can we split into short-term (1 week) vs medium (30 days)?

Jordan Patel: Yes. Short-term = fixes we can ship without infra changes. Medium = runbook rewrites, automation, and cross-region testing.

Priya Singh: Noted. I'm volunteering to own the backup verification checklist for EU and APAC.

Lucas Reed: I can take DNS steering and routing policies (BGP / LB health checks). Will need an ops hour to validate with NetOps.

Mike Ortega: I'll handle the runbook clarity edits and add exact commands & verification steps.

incident-bot: Reminder: postmortem assigned -> DR-2026-03-22. Please attach playbook PRs to that ticket. :white_check_mark: 

Jordan Patel: Short-term action items (owner — ETA):
- Priya Singh — verify snapshot integrity for region-eu and region-apac; run a restore dry-run to staging using the latest s3 archives. ETA: 2026-03-29
- Lucas Reed — confirm DNS failover TTLs and add explicit health-check inversion steps for warm-standby. ETA: 2026-03-28
- Mike Ortega — update runbook step 3 to include KV cache priming and KV cache invalidation command snippets. ETA: 2026-03-26
- Ashley Chen — add a post-failover smoke test matrix and who-runs-what doc. ETA: 2026-03-27

Ashley Chen: For the smoke test matrix I'll start with tokened routes, login flow, and background job processing. Any additions?

Priya Singh: Add backups restore time measurement and verification of customer data subsets (sampling). I'll attach reproducible commands.

Lucas Reed: For DNS steering we need to document the fallback to run-to-region logic + a quick dig/ttl script: 
```
# quick check
dig +short api.redwood.internal @8.8.8.8
curl -sS --head https://api.redwood.internal | head -n 5
```
I'll put a minimal automation that runs these every 10m during game days.

Mike Ortega: Sample restore command I'll add to the runbook: 
```
# restore snapshot to staging
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-backups/region-eu/2026-03-22/snapshot.tar.gz /tmp/
./restore.sh --input /tmp/snapshot.tar.gz --target staging --skip-posthooks=false
```
Include expected durations.

Jordan Patel: Medium-term items (owner — ETA 30 days):
- Ops automation: ops-runbooks to wire automated verification (canary restores + TTL checks) — ops-runbooks — 2026-04-25
- Cross-region choreography: revisit warm-standby warmup procedure and make canary failovers run automatically in CI — Lucas Reed + Priya Singh — 2026-04-25
- Backups policy: enforce retention+consistency checks + signed manifests — Priya Singh — 2026-04-18
- Postmortem patterns: compile recurring incident taxonomy and map to concrete runbook pages — Jordan Patel — 2026-04-01

ops-runbooks: We'll scaffold the automation tasks. Need concrete verification commands from Mike and Priya.

Priya Singh: I'll upload a tiny tool that validates snapshot manifests and will include sample output. Example check: `jq .metadata.version manifest.json` and verify checksums.

Ashley Chen: Suggest adding scheduled quarterly game days with a smaller scope runbook (30m) to keep rotations sharp. Can we make this recurring?

Jordan Patel: Agreed. Quarterly mini-game days + annual full run. Ashley, please propose cadence.

Mike Ortega: Also flagging a recurring pattern: KV cache priming was missed twice in the last year. Let's make it a required checkbox in the runbook with an inline verification command that fails the run if not primed.

Lucas Reed: For routing, during the game day we saw asymmetric ingress due to sticky sessions. Action: set LB cookie timeouts to 5m during failover windows and document rollback. Owner: Lucas. ETA: 2026-03-30

Jordan Patel: Communication plan: during real DR we use #incidents (bridge) + page ops-oncall. Add Ops lead + NetOps lead to oncall rotas when a regional failover is in progress.

Ashley Chen: I'll draft an oncall checklist for communications and escalation. ETA: 2026-03-25

incident-bot: New checklist created: /checklists/dr-game-day-communications (assigned: Ashley Chen)

Mike Ortega: I'll open PRs for runbook edits and tag everyone for review. Expect PR links by EOD today.

Priya Singh: Quick note: during the restore dry-run I hit a permission error for the manifest fetch in eu. I'll add steps to validate IAM roles.

Jordan Patel: Good catch — treat IAM validation as part of the short-term snapshot verification step. Priya, include exact iam:sts and s3 actions to test.

Lucas Reed: NetOps note: BGP route flaps earlier were caused by our healthcheck probe returning 503 for 90s. We should add probe retries in LB config and a temporary suppression during planned failover.

Ashley Chen: Action owners: please update the postmortem ticket DR-2026-03-22 with your task links and ETA. We'll sync in a 30-min checkin tomorrow.

Jordan Patel: Thanks everyone. Quick sync tomorrow 10:30am PT — agenda: review short-term items' PRs and assign blockers. If you can't make it, drop a note in this thread.

Lucas Reed: I'll be there.

Mike Ortega: +1

Priya Singh: +1

Ashley Chen: +1

Jordan Patel: Closing thread for now — keep updates inline. :rocket:
